dispositions.comment: Explicit synthetic topology/password/log regression fixtures use temp DB/files or StringIO and assert rejection, redaction or legacy migration failure behavior. No production credential. See v1.4.0 security triage.

Legacy verification only; new hashes use PBKDF2/600000 iterations/random salts. Login attempts conditional migration; dormant/write-failed SHA256 rows remain weak. Reconfigure sensitive shares. Accepted compatibility risk; see v1.4.0 security triage.

Detected raw/structured, configured and sibling secrets block the complete snapshot; sensitive names are skipped. Clean local plaintext storage is intentional; unknown-secret detection is not guaranteed. Boundary regressions pass; see v1.4.0 security triage.
Snapshot/manifest basenames reject separators, dot names, NUL, symlinks and resolved-parent escapes before sinks. Malicious manifest and link regressions pass. See v1.4.0 security triage.

GitHub download URLs are not fetch destinations; constructed Contents requests use trusted HTTPS API origin. Redirects reject cross-origin/port, HTTP, credentials and writes. Transport regressions pass; Enterprise origin is trusted configuration.
Cookie name contains typed integer report ID; cookie value is a hexadecimal digest, not raw caller-controlled header text. See v1.4.0 security triage.

CloudFormation loader inherits yaml.SafeLoader, has no Python object constructors and custom tags return inert values. Both object/apply branch regressions prove os.system never executes. See v1.4.0 security triage.
